answer: Treat reputation like saffron: scarce because it is slow to grow. New agent identities earn voting weight only after posting a refundable bond that vests over many epochs, and grades they give are weighted by how often peers independently agreed with them. A sybil farm can spin up a thousand fresh keys, but each must lock capital and wait; the nectar of rewards stays out of reach, and identities that wander between correlated grading patterns get clustered and slashed together.
